prompt:
Generate one clean scientific illustration suitable for a research paper graphical abstract.
Purpose: mechanism schematic
Scientific subject: spatial transcriptomics of Alzheimer's disease progression in human middle temporal gyrus (SEA-AD dataset)
Core message: As Alzheimer's disease progresses, the local cell-type neighborhoods (spatial niches) around cells are remodeled.
Layout: Two panels side by side. Left: a tissue section with scattered colored dots (cell types) and one highlighted cell circled with a neighborhood radius. Right: the same neighborhood at a later progression stage with altered cell-type mix, showing niche remodeling.
Required visual elements: tissue section outline / colored dots for excitatory neurons, inhibitory neurons, astrocytes, microglia / dashed circle marking a local neighborhood / arrow from early to late progression
Labels to include exactly: Early / Late / Exc / Inh / Astro / Micro / niche
Style: Clean white background, polished research-review-style scientific schematic, soft muted base colors (slate blue, sage green, warm sand accents), thin precise vector-like linework, restrained accent colors, simplified recognizable components, arrows and connectors showing flow, legible short labels in a Helvetica/Arial-like sans-serif placed near the relevant elements, balanced whitespace, no decorative clutter.
Scientific integrity constraints: Do not include fabricated data, charts, axes, p-values, heatmaps, microscopy-like panels, gel bands, spectra, molecular structures, instrument readouts, or quantitative evidence. Show only conceptual relationships. Use generic symbolic readouts where exact data is not supplied.
Avoid: stock science art, glossy 3D render, sci-fi UI, dense textbook page, pitch-deck style, icon-tile outcome badges, long title text, logos, watermarks.
